newsitem.title: USA: Bangladesh seen seeking 200,000 T wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh seen seeking 200,000 T wheat - trade.

text.p: Bangladesh is expected to tender for about 200,000 tonnes optional origin wheat during the last week of November, several U.S. exporters said.
It would be optional origin and the cheapest wheat, one exporter noted. "I think they are looking at U.S., Australian or Canadian," he said.
One shipment of 100,000 tonnes would be for December delivery and the other 100,000 tonnes would be for January, he said.
"It is possible," another U.S. exporter said. It would be soft white or soft red winter wheat, he said.
"I am hearing rumblings but I cannot confirm it right now," a third U.S. exporter said.
